businesses.business: data analytics and digital operations outsourcing

offering_description.value: Provides data analytics, AI-enabled digital operations and business process outsourcing to large enterprises, mainly in insurance, healthcare, banking and financial services, and utilities. Delivers services through offshore and onshore delivery centers staffed by analysts and operations teams, supported by proprietary platforms and automation.

primary_products.value: analytics and AI software platforms; claims and insurance operations software

primary_services.value: data analytics and AI services; business process outsourcing; insurance claims and policy administration; digital transformation consulting; customer service operations

customer_segment.value: B2B: insurers, healthcare payers and providers, banks, utilities, retailers and other large enterprises

end_markets.value: insurance; healthcare; banking and financial services; utilities; travel, logistics and retail

revenue_model.value: service fees: outsourced operations billed per transaction, per FTE or on outcome basis; project or contract: multi-year analytics and digital transformation engagements

value_chain_position.value: service provider: takes in client data and processes, delivers analytics and outsourced operations to enterprises

geography_served.value: global: clients mainly in the US and UK, with delivery centers in India, the Philippines and elsewhere

specialization.value: related lines: analytics and digital operations/BPO services sharing the same enterprise clients and delivery model

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: enterprise sales teams and account managers selling to large clients

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: handles regulated data for insurers, health payers and banks, HIPAA, GDPR and financial data privacy rules apply
